title: Peter Piper
subtitle: Bilabial Plosive P
description: This exercise drills the explosive /p/ sound, training your lips to create and release a crisp burst of air on every repetition. Rapid /p/ sequences expose and correct any tendency to soften or drop the sound.
tip: Press your lips firmly together before each /p/ and release with a small puff of air — hold a tissue in front of your mouth and make it flutter on every P.
phrases: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.
A peck of pickled peppers Peter Piper picked.
If Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers, where's the peck of pickled peppers Peter Piper picked?
Picky people pick Peter Pan peanut butter.
A proper cup of coffee from a proper copper coffee pot.
Plain plump pandas parade past purple poppies.
